title: Lakeside Watersports
specs: Local captains with expert knowledge of Candlewood Lake's coves, no-wake zones, and sunset spots
Beginner-friendly coaching for all ages and skill levels
No boating license needed for guests when captain service is hired
includes: Licensed captain at the helm handling launch, navigation, docking, and safety
Proper vests for every guest and a spotter for tow sports
Clean, premium MasterCraft wake boats and equipment
blurb: Lakeside Watersports offers watersports lessons and boat activities on Candlewood Lake using clean MasterCraft wake boats. Guests can learn wakeboarding, wakesurfing, tubing, and more with coaching tailored to all levels. They also provide a licensed captain service to run your boat for a smooth and safe day on the water.
